pk.context: 10 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: Cleared mainly by UGT1A9 to an inactive 3-O-glucuronide that accounts for 61% of a dose.

clues.text: Absolute oral bioavailability is 78%, and a high-fat meal does not alter total exposure. About 91% is protein bound, and the drug and its related metabolites are mainly eliminated by the kidneys.
Supplied as a hydrated 1:1:1 complex; the active moiety has molecular weight 408.9.
Marketed under an NDA in 5 mg and 10 mg strengths.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated after serious hypersensitivity to it or its excipients; anaphylaxis and angioedema have been reported.
Chronic kidney disease at risk of progression, heart failure, and type 2 diabetes with cardiovascular disease, plus glycemic control in type 2 diabetes.
Inhibits SGLT2 in the proximal renal tubules, reducing glucose reabsorption and promoting urinary glucose excretion.
The generic name begins with D and has thirteen letters.
